meta.description: Cross-Domain Reconciliation — connecting findings from phases 1-4

findings.issue: ExportData chain broken: API returns CSV binary via sendExportResponse but SDK client.get<Blob>() calls executeFetch which runs res.json() — CSV content cannot be parsed as JSON
findings.impact: Calling tickets.exportData(), projects.exportData(), or audit.exportData() from the SDK will throw a JSON parse error on the CSV response. Export buttons in admin UI are broken end-to-end.
findings.fix: Add client.getBlob() method that uses res.text() or res.blob() with appropriate Content-Type handling. Route export SDK methods through getBlob() instead of get().
findings.chain: schema (tables have data) → api (sendExportResponse writes CSV to res) → sdk (client.get<Blob> calls res.json() → crash) → frontend (export button triggers crash)

findings.issue: Auth entry-point chain broken: 5 authentication pages in (public) route group have no metadata titles AND the route group itself has no loading.tsx. These are the first pages new users encounter — poor SEO and blank loading state.
findings.impact: Login, signup, forgot-password, password-reset, and pending pages show 'Untitled' in browser tab and have no loading skeleton during auth redirects. New user experience degraded.
findings.fix: Add 'export const metadata = { title: "..." }' to all 5 pages. Create apps/web/app/(public)/loading.tsx with a spinner matching the marketing design.
findings.chain: frontend (5 auth pages) → missing metadata → poor SEO/UX when these are the primary entry points to the application

findings.issue: Server action error handling pattern chain: 7 of 12 server action files throw errors directly while only 4 use the project's { ok, error } convention. Callers must handle both patterns (catch block vs check result.ok).
findings.impact: Inconsistent DX for client components consuming server actions. Some use try/catch, others check result.ok. This contradicts AGENTS.md convention: 'Bulk actions: Return { ok, error } instead of throwing'.
findings.fix: Wrap all server action bodies in try/catch that returns { ok, error }. Remove bare 'throw new Error()' calls from server actions. Standardize on result.ok checking in client components.
findings.chain: frontend (server actions) → inconsistent error return pattern → client components must handle both throw and {ok,error} → code debt and potential uncaught errors

findings.issue: Dead schema chain: 10 DB tables (appointments, chat_messages, chat_threads, comments, contracts, contract_signers, document_permissions, onboarding_submissions, project_members, webhook_dead_letters) exist in migrations but have NO API queries, NO SDK methods, and NO frontend pages — dead code across all layers.
findings.impact: 10 tables taking up schema space with no corresponding feature at any layer. Each adds to migration size, seed complexity, and cognitive load when understanding the schema.
findings.fix: Drop 9 tables with no API routes (keep webhook_dead_letters if worker uses it). Verify no worker SQL references them. Add migration: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.comments, public.contracts, ...
findings.chain: schema (10 dead tables) → api (no .from() calls) → sdk (no methods) → frontend (no pages) → full-stack dead code

findings.issue: Ticket comments type mismatch chain: API returns plain TicketComment[] from GET /tickets/:id/comments but SDK types it as PaginatedResult<TicketComment> in listComments(). Frontend components consuming the SDK's listComments() will crash trying to access .data on a plain array.
findings.impact: TypeScript won't catch this at compile time (PaginatedResult<T> has .data as array, and arrays have a .data property that's undefined). At runtime, ticket comment lists will show 'undefined' or crash when rendering.
findings.fix: Change SDK listComments() return type from PaginatedResult<TicketComment> to TicketComment[] to match the API's actual response shape. Verify all callers of listComments() in the frontend handle the correct shape.
findings.chain: api (returns TicketComment[] from GET /:id/comments) → sdk (listComments typed as PaginatedResult<TicketComment> → mismatch) → frontend (components access .data on array → undefined → crash)
